简介: French filmmaker, critic, and editor of the Cahiers du Cinéma, Louis SÉGUIN (France) is noted for his work on short and medium-length films such as Les ronds-points de l’hiver (2015), Saint-Jacques - Gay Lussac (2018) and Bus 96 (2019). He has worked as a film editor in the past and has acted in both his own and other short films. His film Marinaleda (2022) was selected for IFFR 2023.
